items.item_text: Certified Medical Assistant in California or able to obtain certification within six months of hire.
Bachelor's degree in related fields such as Health Sciences, Healthcare Administration, Public Health and or equivalent experience/training.
Experience in Primary Care, Acute Care or Emergency Department setting.
Experience working with adolescent, young adult or college health population.
Experience in a supervisory capacity. Experience working with leading and supervising diverse staff using interpersonal skills, including tact, diplomacy and flexibility.
Experience working in a union environment.
Experience with electronic practice management system and electronic medical records.

Under the direction and supervision of the Student Health and Counseling Services (SHCS) Medical Director, this position functions in a supervisory position overseeing the medical assistants (MA). This supervisor will provide oversight of compliance to department standards, policies, procedures, objectives quality improvement program, safety and environmental and infection control standards. They will be responsible for evaluation of MA performance and develop MA schedules in collaboration with the Medical Director and Medical Staff Supervisor. The MA supervisor will work collaboratively with the Medical Director and Medical Staff Supervisor to ensure delivery of quality patient care. They will be responsible for directing patient care flow. They will actively engage in problem solving and conflict resolution to maintain team cohesiveness and positive patient relations and customer satisfaction. In addition they will participate in quality improvement projects as needed in SHC.
50% - Direct Patient Care and Clinical Workflow Oversight
Critical thinking and problem solving skills to work independently and make clinical decisions within the scope of MA practice.
